title: Speaking — Learning practical skills
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on learning practical skills.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
What practical skills are you confident using?
Who do you ask when you need to learn how something works?

part2.topic: Describe a simple repair you learned to do yourself.
points: what tools or materials you used
part2.closing: and explain why learning it was worth the effort.

questions: Which household skills should schools teach, if any?
How might better repair services affect what people buy?
How has everyday life connected with learning practical skills changed for people of different ages?
